status: implemented, qualified, committed; original goal active
implementation: One general point-coordinate dispatch reuses a chord-pair intersection coordinate from its certified cardinal support, for every counterpart point family. Only a decided reduction replaces the query; uncertainty retains the original fallbacks.

Six family-specific match arms and two redundant chord-pair comparison methods were removed. Existing callers use the shared coordinate query directly; no compatibility interface, replacement point carrier or cache was added.

The support witness remains the existing retained endpoint. It supplies only the requested coordinate; the intersection need not be that endpoint or lie on the finite witness chord. Hypercurve production prefixes shrink by 58 lines.

Both axes, both query directions, both contexts, equality and translated strict orders remain Certified without reconstructing the chord-pair point.
